properties.name: 1876 Burgers - Sbisa Complex
properties.description: Located within the Sbisa Underground Food Court at Texas A&M University, 1876 Burgers offers a variety of classic American comfort foods, including mouthwatering burgers, crispy fries, sandwiches, and fresh salads.

properties.name: The Commons Dining Hall (South Campus)
properties.description: Enjoy all-you-care-to-eat style dining at the Commons Dining Hall! Established in 1971, this dining hall offers menu selections that include home-style fare, build-your-own stirfry, vegan, vegetarian, all-day breakfast, and more! Keep an eye on our events page for our themed events, such as Late Night Food Festival!

properties.name: Aggie Express - Commons
properties.description: Whether you're on the go and need a snack, or forget a scantron before an exam, Aggie Express has got you covered! These convenience store locations carry all things from fresh sushi to phone chargers and school supplies. Aggie Express makes it convenient to find the things you need!
